report.summary: Sourcing is unusually tight: every number, year, rupee figure and name checked (revenue, EBITDA, net profit, borrowings, total assets, ₹405.02 lakhs, 57%/52% concentration, 74,95,476 shares / 90.949%, ₹68.4/₹57.7/₹324.3 lakhs, ages 28/26, March 2016 strike-offs) traces back to the cited page's excerpts, and the derived table matches the restated statements once reversed to FY2018-first order. One citation is mis-targeted: the tag_index 8 sentence attributes the railways/bridges/roads work descriptions to drhp-p63 when that detail is on drhp-p71 (p63 supports only the RMC-plant half), so the tag should be re-pointed at drhp-p71 (keeping drhp-p63 for the RMC clause). No other unsupported or wrong-page citations and no untagged company-specific claims were found; several sentences correctly present absences (no competitor named, no peer names, no segment revenue split, no negative-cash-flow quantum) as absences.
